info.longName: Goldman Sachs MarketBeta(R) Total International Equity ETF

funds_data.description: The index is designed to measure the performance of equity securities of large and mid-capitalization equity issuers covering approximately the largest 85% of the free-float market capitalization in the global markets excluding the United States. The fund generally seeks to invest in the index components in approximately the same weighting that such components have within the index at the applicable time.
